This documentary, featuring new interviews with the Pythons and home-movie glimpses of fledging Python-mania, follows the troupe's long and winding road to the States, acknowledging the unsung heroes in the Python story.

This reunion show features the five surviving members of Monty Python, with Graham Chapman in attendance in the form of his "ashes" being brought out in an urn. The Pythons look back at their work and receive an American Film Industry award.
